row.name: 基希克斯破封
row.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.

encounters.name: Kith'ix
encounters.description: Defeated long ago, Kith'ix was restrained deep in the Vaults of Ula'tek by Ula'tek herself. With her defeat, the C'Thraxxi has returned, intent on wiping out not just the Amani, but any who would oppose him.

sections.title: Overview

descriptions.14:
Kith'ix calls upon his [Voidswarm] to fight alongside him as he assaults players with an array of powerful dark magic.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Kith'ix attempts to smother his enemies with [Suffocating Darkness]. Lady Liadrin holds the darkness at bay while gathering power to banish it with [Divine Radiance].

At 25% health, Kith'ix stuns players with [Stygian Howl] and Liadrin rescues them with [Last Light], beginning a race to slay Kith'ix before his [Eightfold Eclipse] snuffs out Liadrin's light.
